preconditions.description: The length of the given sequence is between 2 and 30000.
The elements of the sequence are integers within the range of -10^8 to 10^8.

postconditions.expression: Output is either two arithmetic progressions or 'No solution'
postconditions.description: The output must be either two lines of numbers representing the two arithmetic progressions, or a single line with 'No solution' if it's impossible to split the sequence into two arithmetic progressions.
